goal.objective: Verify that the canonical StegVerse heartbeat is derivable from the durable HB32 protocol anchor at 10 ms / 100 Hz without a resident daemon, persisted state, worker state, GitHub runtime, or third-party process becoming causal to progression.
success_predicates: control/heartbeat-protocol-anchor.json is the canonical post-cutover anchor.
The same timestamp derives the same reference independent of observer state.
Less than 10 ms does not increment and exactly 10 ms increments once.
Delayed observation skips independently existing references according to elapsed phase.
Persisted/worker/task state cannot override the post-cutover protocol anchor.
A continuously running resident process is not required for heartbeat progression.
Optional sampler observations remain authority-neutral snapshots.
No GitHub token or NON-TV/TVC secret/token is required or forwarded.
failure_predicates: LIVE-009 waits for resident-start 012 merely to establish heartbeat existence.
A resident process, repository event, worker, task, observer, claim, fence, lease, or persisted snapshot becomes heartbeat progression authority.
A post-cutover observer derives from a local/historical anchor instead of control/heartbeat-protocol-anchor.json.
A NON-TV/TVC credential or GitHub token becomes runtime authority.
A third-party runtime becomes required or primary.

task.derivation_reason: Canonical semantics already require missed references to exist independently of observation. The prior resident-start dependency incorrectly treated a sampler process as the condition that made heartbeat references exist. The durable protocol anchor makes the semantics executable directly.

bootstrap_sequence: derive two or more canonical references at controlled timestamps
activation.bootstrap_semantics: LIVE-009 verifies the already-defined protocol oscillator. It does not start or keep the heartbeat alive. Optional resident sampling may be tested separately but is not a prerequisite for protocol progression.

completion.next_authorized_action: Validate the canonical protocol-anchor invariants and persist terminal LIVE-009 evidence. Do not wait for HEARTBEAT-OSCILLATOR-RESIDENT-START-012.
terminal_when: HB32 is derived at the canonical anchor instant.
same timestamp produces same reference independent of persisted/worker state.
less than 10 ms produces no increment and exactly 10 ms produces one increment.
delayed observation skips independently existing references.
No GitHub workflow, resident sampler, observer, or worker is represented as heartbeat progression authority.
